title: A nonconstant morphism of curves with normal target is flat
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X,Y$ be curves over $k$: separated integral schemes of finite type and dimension one [def-pc-curve]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a $k$-morphism whose image contains at least two points. Suppose $Y$ is normal, meaning that every local ring $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ is an integral domain integrally closed in its fraction field [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Then $f$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism].
